title: Train a character bigram language model
summary: Train a table of next-character logits with gradient descent until the held-out negative log-likelihood beats a unigram model.

target.metric: held-out mean negative log-likelihood (nats per character)

mutants.target_as_context: Counts each next character as its own context, so the model never learns which character follows which.
mutants.reversed_pairs: Swaps context and target, so the model predicts the previous character from the next one.
mutants.returns_logits: Returns the raw logits from next_log_probs and forgets the log softmax.
mutants.lr_wrong_sign: Adds the gradient to W instead of subtracting it, so the loss goes up.
mutants.global_rng: Draws the first logits from np.random and not from the rng argument, so two runs with one seed differ.
mutants.over_budget: Trains for 400 steps, more than the budget of 300.
